mapper.sql: FROM biz_delivery_report r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.reporter_id AND u.deleted_at = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.primary_department_id AND d.deleted_at = 0 WHERE r.deleted_at = 0 AND r.report_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND r.reporter_id = #{userId} AND LOCATE(#{reporter}, u.display_name) > 0 AND LOCATE(#{project}, r.project_name) > 0 AND LOCATE(#{line}, r.agency_line_name) > 0
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.report_date, r.reporter_id, u.english_nickname AS reporter_english_name, u.display_name AS reporter_name, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '未设置') AS department_name, r.project_id, r.project_name, r.agency_line_id, r.agency_line_name, r.platform, r.metrics_json
ORDER BY r.report_date DESC, r.reporter_id, r.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.id, r.report_date, r.reporter_id, u.english_nickname AS reporter_english_name, u.display_name AS reporter_name, COALESCE(d.dept_name, '未设置') AS department_name, r.project_id, r.project_name, r.agency_line_id, r.agency_line_name, r.platform, r.metrics_json, r.account_ids_json, r.campaign_ids_json FROM biz_delivery_report r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.reporter_id AND u.deleted_at = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.primary_department_id AND d.deleted_at = 0 WHERE r.deleted_at = 0 AND r.reporter_id = #{userId} AND r.id IN #{id} ORDER BY r.report_date, r.project_id, r.id

SELECT CAST(a.report_id AS CHAR) AS report_id, CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS id, f.original_name AS name, o.mime_type FROM biz_delivery_report_attachment a JOIN sys_file f ON f.id = a.file_id AND f.deleted_at = 0 JOIN sys_file_object o ON o.id = f.file_object_id AND o.deleted_at = 0 WHERE a.deleted_at = 0 AND a.report_id IN #{id} ORDER BY a.report_id, a.sort_order, a.id

SELECT CAST(u.id AS CHAR) AS id, u.display_name AS name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.deleted_at = 0 AND u.id = #{userId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted_at = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = u.id AND ur.deleted_at = 0 AND r.role_code = 'OPERATOR' ) ORDER BY u.display_name, u.id
SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id, display_name AS name FROM sys_user WHERE deleted_at = 0 AND id = #{userId} ORDER BY display_name, id
SELECT DISTINCT report_date FROM biz_delivery_report WHERE reporter_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at = 0 AND report_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY report_date
SELECT d.dept_name FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.primary_department_id AND d.deleted_at = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.deleted_at = 0
SELECT english_nickname FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT english_nickname FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT id FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) AS project_id, p.project_name, CAST(l.id AS CHAR) AS agency_line_id, l.line_name AS agency_line_name FROM pm_agency_line l JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = l.project_id AND p.deleted_at = 0 WHERE l.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY p.project_name, l.line_name, l.id

SELECT id, report_date, reporter_id, reporter_english_name, project_id, project_name, agency_line_id, agency_line_name, platform, metrics_json, account_ids_json, campaign_ids_json FROM biz_delivery_report WHERE reporter_id = #{userId} AND report_date = #{date} AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_delivery_report ( report_date, reporter_id, reporter_english_name, project_id, project_name, agency_line_id, agency_line_name, platform, metrics_json, account_ids_json, campaign_ids_json ) VALUES ( #{reportDate}, #{reporterId}, #{reporterEnglishName}, #{projectId}, #{projectName}, #{agencyLineId}, #{agencyLineName}, #{platform}, #{metricsJson}, COALESCE(#{accountIdsJson}, '[]'), COALESCE(#{campaignIdsJson}, '[]') ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), reporter_english_name = VALUES(reporter_english_name), project_name = VALUES(project_name), agency_line_name = VALUES(agency_line_name), metrics_json = VALUES(metrics_json), account_ids_json = COALESCE(#{accountIdsJson}, account_ids_json), campaign_ids_json = COALESCE(#{campaignIdsJson}, campaign_ids_json), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS id, f.original_name AS name, o.mime_type FROM biz_delivery_report_attachment a JOIN sys_file f ON f.id = a.file_id AND f.deleted_at = 0 JOIN sys_file_object o ON o.id = f.file_object_id AND o.deleted_at = 0 WHERE a.report_id = #{reportId} AND a.deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY a.sort_order, a.id

SELECT CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS id, f.original_name AS name, o.mime_type FROM sys_file f JOIN sys_file_object o ON o.id = f.file_object_id AND o.deleted_at = 0 WHERE f.uploader_id = #{userId} AND f.deleted_at = 0 AND o.storage_status = 'AVAILABLE' AND o.mime_type IN ('image/png', 'image/jpeg', 'image/webp', 'image/gif') AND f.id IN #{id} ORDER BY f.id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_delivery_report_attachment SET deleted_at = UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000 WHERE report_id = #{reportId} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_delivery_report_attachment (report_id, file_id, sort_order) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{fileId}, #{sortOrder})
